description: Send a list of NPIs (up to 500) for a provider enrollment check. Each provider gets one row from public records: the national NPI registry, the Medicare revalidation due date, Medicare enrollment and group reassignments, the federal exclusion list, state license status and expiry, and the places those records disagree (name, license number, state). When the registry lists no license number, the board is searched by the provider's name. Every cell has its source link and read time, and a record that could not be read is marked so in its own cell, never guessed. Results start in seconds. State licenses are read in California, Florida, New Jersey, New York, Pennsylvania and Texas; one there that cannot be settled right away is read by a person within 48 hours, and a license in another state or of a type we do not read yet is marked not checked with the board's link. We email the full table when the check finishes. The first check is free.

npis.description: 10-digit NPIs, up to 500 valid ones; use instead of text. Entries that are not valid NPIs are listed back with a reason.

text.description: Pasted text with NPIs anywhere in it; use instead of npis.
